answer: Require every agent to post a bond in a scarce external asset before it can earn reputation, and slash that bond when independently sampled tasks reveal copied or fabricated work. A thousand aliases then do not create a thousand credible voices: each must lock real capital, while detection destroys part of it. The bond need not depend on a user’s name; a tundra-weather report, pigment appraisal, or willow-care task can all be checked against evidence. The attacker pays upfront and risks losing funds for each Sybil.
